program: Hydrogen Systems and Enabling Technologies (HySET Erasmus Mundus Joint Master)

curriculum.value: Hydrogen value chain; consortium mobility across Politecnico di Torino, Politecnico di Milano and partner universities

application_route.value: Apply@PoliTO portal; Politecnico di Torino coordinates document review

application_windows.notes: The current 2027–29 intake notice gives the exact close time.

value.additional_background: Applicants in Physics, Chemistry, Aeronautical Engineering or Electrical Engineering must show thermodynamics, heat transfer and fluid mechanics; a stronger chemistry background is required for the TU/e destination.

value.Cambridge_CAE: 160; 180 with minimum 169 each section for TU/e destination
value.waiver: Only for qualifying nationals of English-speaking countries taught and evaluated in English

value.academic_achievements: up to 30 points; page references GPA at least 3.0/4.0 in the scoring description

selection_criteria.notes: The GPA reference appears within the scored academic-achievements criterion; the source does not present it as a separate universal minimum eligibility rule.

application_fee.notes: No application fee is stated in the reviewed 2027–29 call pages.

payment_structure.value: May be paid in full or in instalments; payment method and deadlines will be provided later.
